Body.DeclarationsIntro: Declarations take effect according to their content and receipt; processing is not a legal precondition. Resolve unverified cases promptly and monitor pending confirmations and dates.
Body.MarkDeclarationProcessedHint: Review the full declaration and original agreement evidence. An email match alone does not prove identity. Processing never changes receipt time.
Body.DeclarationEffectiveEndHint: end date confirmed to the declarant
Body.ImmediateReview: Review immediately: original receipt and requested date govern. Reconcile later debits and preserve paid access.
Body.DeclarationActionHint: Scheduling targets the original current renewal agreement under its period rules, with no new consent or retrospective debit. External handling records actions already taken and a sent response; it makes no automatic account change. Document deviations, late processing, restitution review and communication.
Body.DeclarationVerified: Identity and contract sufficiently verified; original receipt, effect and verified communication evidence recorded in the note.

Commercial.about: The system opens a case when an account is deleted. It records which documents we keep for it and whether any balance is still open. The list counts a case as to do as soon as one of these records is due for review. It does not count items that are still to be determined; you find them in the case under “Money”.
Commercial.subject: Account ID
Commercial.capacityHelp: How do I read these figures?
Commercial.capacityLimit: “Refundable at most” is the upper limit that follows from the purchases. It is not yet a claim to a payout. While earlier refunds are unknown, the limit stays open.

basis.live_original_claimant_capture_records: Basis: the purchase payments of the existing account.
basis.preserved_original_claimant_erasure_obse: Basis: the state recorded when the account was deleted.

Commercial.unknownCapacityCount: Bookings without a known purchase share
Commercial.knownSelector: You need the exact number of the document. There is no search here.
Commercial.rawDetail: The export contains everything stored for this case, including personal details.

HoldReview.title: Retention
HoldReview.intro: We keep these records for the case. In a review you note why a record stays and when you will look at it again.
HoldReview.effect: The record stays retained and gets the new review date. Nothing is deleted, released or paid out.
HoldReview.more: There are more than 100 retained records. These are the ones with the earliest date; “Next 100” shows the following ones.
HoldReview.empty: We keep no records for this case.
HoldReview.emptyPage: None of the loaded records belongs to this case.
HoldReview.noReview: This record has never been reviewed.
HoldReview.assessment: Why does the record stay? (at least 20 characters)
HoldReview.dateHint: With time and time zone. Quick choice:
HoldReview.scope: I have reviewed the record and it stays retained.
HoldReview.subject: Account ID
HoldReview.retryHint: It is open whether the server received the review. Simply send it again; it will not be saved twice.
HoldReview.localHistory: An earlier confirmation already exists for this entry.
HoldReview.receipt: Saved. The next review is due on {date}.
HoldReview.local: What you prepared with “Continue” and have not sent yet lives only in this tab. Save it as a file if you want to carry on later.

errors.prepare: That did not work yet. Check the reason (at least 20 characters) and the date (with time and time zone). If both are right, reload the list.

errors.import: The file does not fit. Nothing was changed.
errors.actor: Another admin account prepared this review. Only that account can send it.
errors.unconfirmed: The server did not confirm. Send the review again; it will not be saved twice.
errors.receiptStorage: The server has saved it. Only the browser's temporary storage could not be tidied up; save the entry as a file to be safe.

Determination.title: Determination
Determination.intro: Choose an item under “Money” above. With the determination you set how much is owed from it.
Determination.byId: Open an item by its ID
Determination.unitsHint: 100 units are 1 EUR. Enter whole units, for example 1250 for 12.50 EUR.
Determination.cashKnown: I know which part of it is to be refunded as money
Determination.cashBasis: What does that follow from? (at least 20 characters)
Determination.confirm: I have checked the item, the amounts and the evidence.
Determination.notPending: This item is already determined. There is nothing more to enter here.
Determination.uncertain: It is open whether the server received this determination. Check with the server or send it again; it will not be counted twice.
Determination.claimed: The file contains confirmations. They only count once the server confirms them here.
Determination.noJournal: The server does not know this determination yet. Send it if it should apply.
Determination.receipt: Saved: the item is determined. Nothing was paid out.
Determination.receiptUnsaved: The server has saved it. Only the copy in the browser could not be removed.
Determination.local: What you prepared with “Continue” and have not sent yet lives only in this tab. Save it as a file if you want to carry on later.
Determination.keepOriginalFile: Keep the file. It was neither changed nor sent here.
